@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This area is not open to any tourists or hunters for the purpose of w______e protection.
= wildlife
~詞義 wildlife（n.）野生生物
~原文 This area is not open to any tourists or hunters for the purpose of wildlife protection.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The coach s______ted another player for the injured captain during the game.
= substituted
~詞義 substitute（v.）以…代替…
~原文 The coach substituted another player for the injured captain during the game.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: When peaceful talks failed, the workers r______ted to striking to make their complaints heard.
= resorted
~詞義 resort（v.）訴諸於
~原文 When peaceful talks failed, the workers resorted to striking to make their complaints heard.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I s______ed on the doorstep when I entered the restaurant, but, thankfully, I wasn't injured.
= stumbled
~詞義 stumble（v.）絆倒
~原文 I stumbled on the doorstep when I entered the restaurant, but, thankfully, I wasn't injured.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: One way to distinguish m______ls from other animals is that they usually have hair or fur covering most of their skin.
= mammals
~詞義 mammal（n.）哺乳動物
~原文 One way to distinguish mammals from other animals is that they usually have hair or fur covering most of their skin.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher asked Alex for a(n) ______ for his late assignment, but he couldn't give a convincing explanation.
A: initiative
B: justification
C: specimen
D: modification
= B
~詞義 justification（n.）正當性
~原文 The teacher asked Alex for a(n) justification for his late assignment, but he couldn't give a convincing explanation.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The mayor's affair has become a huge ______; many people have predicted that he will not win the next election.
A: innovation
B: mattress
C: prospect
D: scandal
= D
~詞義 scandal（n.）醜聞
~原文 The mayor's affair has become a huge scandal; many people have predicted that he will not win the next election.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Scientists have proven that dust may ______ allergies in young children and can even lead to more serious diseases.
A: institute
B: rival
C: modify
D: trigger
= D
~詞義 trigger（v.）引發
~原文 Scientists have proven that dust may trigger allergies in young children and can even lead to more serious diseases.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The church offers shelter to the homeless, who can find ______ there on cold winter nights.
A: series
B: refuge
C: scent
D: tribute
= B
~詞義 refuge（n.）避難
~原文 The church offers shelter to the homeless, who can find refuge there on cold winter nights.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ of the apartment building got together for a meeting about their new noisy neighbor.
A: performers
B: residents
C: settings
D: institutions
= B
~詞義 resident（n.）居民
~原文 The residents of the apartment building got together for a meeting about their new noisy neighbor.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: toxic
B: ratio
C: preference
D: residence
E: overall
F: innovative

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mina has a(n) ______ for classical music over pop songs because it helps her relax.
= C
~詞義 preference（n.）偏好
~原文 Mina has a(n) preference for classical music over pop songs because it helps her relax.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Terry often comes up with ______ yet practical ideas. That's why everyone likes to have him on their team.
= F
~詞義 innovative（adj.）創新的
~原文 Terry often comes up with innovative yet practical ideas. That's why everyone likes to have him on their team.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The river turned pink because the factory had been discharging ______ wastewater into it.
= A
~詞義 toxic（adj.）有毒的
~原文 The river turned pink because the factory had been discharging toxic wastewater into it.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Though Steve failed mathematics, his ______ performance in the midterm exams wasn't that bad.
= E
~詞義 overall（adj.）全面的
~原文 Though Steve failed mathematics, his overall performance in the midterm exams wasn't that bad.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ of water to flour in this bread recipe is 3 to 5; you need to add three cups of water for every five cups of flour.
= B
~詞義 ratio（n.）比例
~原文 The ratio of water to flour in this bread recipe is 3 to 5; you need to add three cups of water for every five cups of flour.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: penetrate
B: specimens
C: likewise
D: radiation
E: initiative
F: marine

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The biology teacher has a collection of beautiful butterfly ______ which are kept in glass cases at the back of the classroom.
= B
~詞義 specimen（n.）標本
~原文 The biology teacher has a collection of beautiful butterfly specimens which are kept in glass cases at the back of the classroom.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: After the nuclear explosion, many plants and animals in the region became diseased because of the effects of ______.
= D
~詞義 radiation（n.）輻射
~原文 After the nuclear explosion, many plants and animals in the region became diseased because of the effects of radiation.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sherry was asked to help with the house chores by her mom and her brother ______.
= C
~詞義 likewise（adv.）同樣地
~原文 Sherry was asked to help with the house chores by her mom and her brother likewise.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: If you want to impress your boss, try to complete some tasks on your own ______.
= E
~詞義 initiative（n.）主動性
~原文 If you want to impress your boss, try to complete some tasks on your own initiative.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Nowadays, ______ life is threatened by environmental pollution, especially plastic pollution in the sea.
= F
~詞義 marine（adj.）海洋的
~原文 Nowadays, marine life is threatened by environmental pollution, especially plastic pollution in the sea.
